# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student


def _require_email(student: Student) -> None:
    if not student.email:
        name = student.display_name
        raise ValueError(f"no email for student: {name}")


def _format_row(student: Student, width: int) -> str:
    name = student.display_name
    return f"{name:<{width}}  {student.section:<8}  {student.email}"


# ---
def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Text rows sorted by name, columns lined up."""
    members = list(students)
    if not members:
        raise ValueError("no students for the contact sheet")
    for student in members:
        _require_email(student)
    ordered = sorted(members, key=lambda pupil: pupil.display_name)
    width = max(len(pupil.display_name) for pupil in ordered)
    return [_format_row(pupil, width) for pupil in ordered]
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows


def make(last, first, section="A", email="x@y.org"):
    return Student("1", last, first, section, email)


class ContactRowsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_sorted_by_name(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Zed", "Al"), make("Abe", "Bo")])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Abe, Bo"))
        self.assertTrue(rows[1].startswith("Zed, Al"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        rows = contact_rows([make("Long", "Name"), make("Li", "Al")])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0].index("x@y"), rows[1].index("x@y"))

    def test_row_has_section_and_email(self):
        row = contact_rows([make("Li", "Al", "B", "al@li.org")])[0]
        self.assertIn("B", row)
        self.assertTrue(row.endswith("al@li.org"))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as caught:
            contact_rows([make("Li", "Al", email=None)])
        self.assertIn("Li, Al", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
